title: dai-ui/1: surface, node catalog and action declarations (LLD-17)
description: Normative draft. A surface is a tree of catalog nodes plus a data model and server-declared actions. x-class: model_safe nodes may be authored by a model, server_only nodes only by trusted server code. x-container: the node may have children. x-server-only-props: props a model-authored tree must not carry.

id.description: Local identifier, unique within one surface (node ids and action ids).

uuid.description: UUID in canonical lowercase form (persisted ids are UUIDv7).

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the surface data model.

dataRef.description: Read binding: replaced by the value found at the pointer when rendering.

predicate.description: Closed, side-effect-free visibility predicate over the surface data model; combinators nest at most three levels (unrolled, so validation stays linear).

outcome.description: respond only: which outcome this action resolves the interrupt with.

submit.description: Pointer of the data-model object the client sends as values.

digest.description: Opaque; the client echoes it in expect.digest.

actionDecl.description: Client-visible action declaration. The handler, arguments and authority live only on the server.

anchor.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset into the assistant message text where the surface belongs; absent = after the text.

node.description: Dispatch on type with if/then so each node is validated exactly once. Do not turn this into oneOf over the node_* definitions: with recursive children that costs exponential time in the depth of the tree.
